skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Holiday HD78
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD78. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
skins.quote: 'As long as I can keep enjoying my vacation, I'm happy to defend the innocent for the rest of my life!'

skins.name: High Autumn
skins.content: Vitafield [Camper] Series Classics/High Autumn. Designed for outdoor activities, providing extra support for the body. The comfortable and breathable fabric dries quickly.
skins.quote: Proviso leaves the office and its documents behind and comes upon a field painted in autumn. There is no need for argument or jargon here, you can simply express what you feel.
